messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a small kernel patch + quant profile tweak tonight at 23:00 UTC. Low-risk NV attention bounds fix but touches 8-bit path. Need a deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback plan. Canaries only, no mass ramp until we validate.

sam: I can own 23:00–23:30 UTC window. Will do a single-node canary on slice p1 then increase to canary-5 if healthy. @jordan can you take 23:30–00:00 as fallback?

jordan: Yep I can take the later half. Ping me 15m before handoff.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: PR #4211 -> canary-1 -> canary-5 -> ramp. Playbook: /deploys/engine/4211 (internal). CI passed for linux/gpu and quant unit tests.

erin: Quick q — any model-variant incompatibilities? Do we need to pin quant profiles for older model tags?

maya: Good call. This change requires an explicit quant profile bump for acme-13 and base-7 (non-breaking for others). Canary build tags: `engine:v0.9.7-qa` + `quant:1.2.4`. Rollback image: `engine:v0.9.6` + `quant:1.2.3`.

ben: Metric gates (proposal): abort if p95 latency > baseline +15% for 5m OR error rate >0.5% for 5m. Also fail if token decoding errors >0.2%. We should also watch KV cache miss rate.

sam: Short smoke checklist — copyable:
1) deploy canary to slice p1 (1 node)
2) run smoke script `scripts/smoke_engine_check.sh p1`
3) validate logs for `kv-cache-resize` and no `CUDA_OOM` within first 5m
4) run sample generation from `acme-13` and `base-7`, diff against baseline
5) check dashboards: latency (p50/p95), error-rate, token-fail-rate, kv-cache-hit

Sample commands:
```bash
# deploy canary
ci-deploy --pr 4211 --slice p1 --tag engine:v0.9.7-qa --profile quant-1.2.4
# tail logs
rwinfctl logs --slice p1 --since 15m | grep -E "kv-cache-resize|CUDA_OOM|ERROR"
# run smoke script
bash scripts/smoke_engine_check.sh p1
# quick sample gen (local client)
python tools/smoke_sample.py --model acme-13 --endpoint https://canary.p1.rwinf.internal --prompt "The history of..."
```

jordan: Where should we look for canary logs? Kibana link or `rwinfctl logs` works. Also include the perf traces: trace id printed by the smoke script.

maya: PR link: https://git.company/redwood-inference/engine/pull/4211 — CR notes in the PR. @ben you had a kv allocation comment?

ben: I left one inline, pushed a tiny tweak to the allocator bound. LGTM once telemetry alarms are verified. Also added a note to the playbook about memory thresholds.

ops-bot: Reminder: deploys that touch runtime kernels require oncall overlap of 2 hours. Please ack.

maya: Acknowledged. Oncall window confirmed. I'll kick off at 23:00 UTC. Sam — ping me when the initial canary is healthy and you start ramp. :rocket:

sam: Ack. Running synthetic coverage and will drop a short diff of sample outputs to #eng-runtime once canary passes smoke.

jordan: Rollback steps (if needed):
```bash
# rollback to previous image + quant profile
deploy rollback --pr 4211 --to-tag engine:v0.9.6 --profile quant-1.2.3 --force
# verify
rwinfctl check --slice p1 --since 10m
```

maya: Thanks all — I'll leave a post-deploy summary in this thread. Quick note: try to avoid model churn during handoff; if you need to test other models keep it limited to synthetic prompts.

sam: Canary started at 23:03 UTC (small delay). Smoke script ran, no CUDA_OOM, kv-cache resize logs present. Posting sample diffs now.

maya: Saw the diffs, looks within acceptable divergence for ACME-13. Ramping to canary-5.

sam: Ramp done, monitoring 15m window. No anomalies so far.

jordan: I'll standby for 23:30 handoff in case we need rollback.

maya: Great job — leaving monitoring for next 30m then we'll mark this as staged. Will post final summary after 1h. — maya
